Questions: [8 marks] A practical task in Applied Physics involves this requirement: identify the specific purpose or behaviour of Definition of unit in Units, Dimensions and Measurements. Explain how Definition of unit applies, outline the main steps and justify the result with an example.

[8 marks] A practical task in Applied Physics involves this requirement: explain why motion remains unchanged unless a non-zero resultant external force acts. Explain how Inertia applies, outline the main steps and justify the result with an example.

[8 marks] A practical task in Applied Physics involves this requirement: identify the specific purpose or behaviour of Stress & strain along with their types in Properties of Matter. Explain how Stress & strain along with their types applies, outline the main steps and justify the result with an example.

[8 marks] A practical task in Applied Physics involves this requirement: Unit systems and measurement standards are used to express physical quantities consistently.. Explain how Fundamental and Derived units applies, outline the main steps and justify the result with an example.
Answers:
Model answer (8 marks)

**Meaning/purpose (2 marks):** Definition of unit is covered in “Units, Dimensions and Measurements”. A good answer should define its purpose, explain its main components or steps, connect it to Fundamental and Derived units, systems of units- CGS, MKS and SI, introduction to accuracy, provide a practical example and state how the result can be checked.

**Principles/steps (3 marks):** Explain the concept in logical order and relate it to syllabus areas such as Fundamental and Derived units; systems of units- CGS; MKS and SI; introduction to accuracy. State relevant components, formulas, assumptions or procedures.

**Application/example (2 marks):** Apply it to a concrete Applied Physics problem; identify the objective, selected method and expected outcome.

**Verification/conclusion (1 mark):** Check the outcome against the objective and mention a meaningful limitation, error source or trade-off.

Marking guide: meaning/purpose 2; principles/steps 3; application/example 2; verification/conclusion 1.

Model answer (8 marks)

**Meaning/purpose (2 marks):** Newton's first law says an object remains at rest or moves uniformly in a straight line unless a non-zero resultant force acts. Inertia is resistance to changing motion.

**Principles/steps (3 marks):** Explain the concept in logical order and relate it to syllabus areas such as Newton's first law of motion; momentum; Newton’s second law of motion; conservation of momentum. State relevant components, formulas, assumptions or procedures.

**Application/example (2 marks):** Apply it to a concrete Applied Physics problem; identify the objective, selected method and expected outcome.

**Verification/conclusion (1 mark):** Check the outcome against the objective and mention a meaningful limitation, error source or trade-off.

Marking guide: meaning/purpose 2; principles/steps 3; application/example 2; verification/conclusion 1.
